name: The rewards-posting derivations are one package of the accounting section
asks: Move `derive-set-of-rewards-postings.mjs` (consumer-credit-services-section/services/derive-set-of-rewards-postings-service/scripts/) into a new package in computer-accounting-systems-engineering-services-section/scripts/ that exports it, and delete the original package; move `route-card-rewards.mjs` (consumer-credit-services-section/services/route-card-rewards-service/scripts/) to the same place and delete its package; cut any consumer of the deleted packages over to the new computer-accounting-systems section. (2026-09-10)

And the original package deleted.

requirements.says: The computer-accounting-systems section shall provide one package under its scripts/ directory that exports derive-set-of-rewards-postings and route-card-rewards.
The financial-engineering consumer-credit section shall contain neither the derive-set-of-rewards-postings-service package nor the route-card-rewards-service package.
Every consumer of the two removed packages shall import the new accounting package.

x-provenance.pending-conditions: No met-when was stated; this condition stands unsettled (read unknown) until a check that exercises the requirement replaces it.
x-provenance.state-found: At this pass the two source paths named in the utterance are not in the tracked tree (git ls-files finds no consumer-credit-services-section and no file named for either script); the rewards code that exists is in the hive sections (holozing rewards) and route-directed-yield-service. The migration is therefore a landing of the named scripts from wherever they are held, judged before any deletion under rule existing-work-is-judged-before-it-is-discarded; this record carries the whole instruction and is the work order for that landing, not code.
